meta.name: cheat-score-blind
meta.description: INTERNAL sub-agent, not a user-facing skill. Performs context-isolated nine-dimension rubric scoring for cheat-score, cheat-predict, and cheat-bump. Accepts only script and rubric-note paths, returns strict JSON, and refuses post-publish evidence.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 对内部子代理进行九维评分
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要内部子代理执行评分任务
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need an internal sub-agent for scoring tasks

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会变成一个内部评分员，只根据你提供的脚本和评分规则文件，对脚本进行 7 或 9 个维度的打分，并返回严格的 JSON 数据。它不会读取任何历史数据或用户对话。
howto.when: 当主 Claude 调用内部任务（如 cheat-score、cheat-predict、cheat-bump）时，会触发这个子 agent 进行盲评。用户无法直接触发。

say.text: 请对这篇脚本进行盲评。
say.note: Claude 会启动内部评分流程。

say.text: 帮我检查一下这个脚本的评分。
say.note: Claude 会调用子 agent 进行独立打分。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude becomes an internal scorer that evaluates a script based solely on the provided script and rubric notes, returning a strict JSON with scores for 7 or 9 dimensions. It refuses to read any historical data or user conversation.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the main Claude invokes internal tasks like cheat-score, cheat-predict, or cheat-bump to perform blind scoring. Users cannot trigger it directly.

say_en.note: Claude will start the internal scoring process.

say_en.text: Check the score for this script.
say_en.note: Claude will invoke the sub-agent for independent scoring.
